name: Liv
title: Waykeeper Envoy
examine: Sent by Marshal Kestrel to say no: the order lights no road it cannot walk. Two years of saying it, from the loneliest post the lamp-faith keeps, and the no keeps getting quieter.
lines: The order's answer is still no. My answer is getting complicated.
A lamp you cannot tend is a lie in glass. That is doctrine. I wrote it out nine times.
I watch the gate. Somebody from the order ought to.
